result.title: Beyond Similarity Entropy: A Rank-Guided Data-Free Quantization Framework for Vision Transformers
result.summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated remarkable performance, yet their computational and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment on mobile devices. Data-free quantization (DFQ) enables the compression of ViTs without access to their original training data. Existing DFQ methods often synthesize calibration samples by maximizing the entropy of patch similarity. However, similarity entropy describes the dispersion of similarity values without ensuring that the generated samples cover diverse feature directions, potentially limiting their effectiveness for quantization calibration. To address this limitation, we propose RankQ-ViT, a rank-guided DFQ framework for ViTs. We first observe that patch similarity matrices derived from Gaussian noise tend to have lower ranks than those derived from real images. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a block-aware self-contrastive objective that promotes feature diversity during synthetic data generation without explicitly computing matrix rank at each optimization step. We then select calibration samples based on their rank and semantic consistency and use them for block-wise reconstruction of the quantized model. Experiments on ImageNet, COCO, ModelNet40, and ShapeNet demonstrate the effectiveness of RankQ-ViT across multiple architectures and tasks, particularly under low-bit quantization. The code is available at https://github.com/Runqing-forMost/rankq-vit.git

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RankQ-ViT 无数据量化框架：作者观察到高斯噪声生成的 patch 相似度矩阵比真实图像秩更低，于是用 block-aware 自对比目标在合成校准样本时促进特征方向多样性，并按秩与语义一致性筛选样本用于分块重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以 patch 相似度矩阵的秩衡量特征方向多样性，可能为诊断 latent 视觉状态是否保留细节、以及相似度结构受位置与注意力影响提供可核查的度量线索，但论文本身针对量化校准，不涉及推理期状态生成或答案使用。
